content.text:
I couldn't get the FY 2024 totals for Spirit's operating KPIs. **Not found with these tools.**

**What I could confirm**

Spirit Airlines' FY 2024 10-K (filed 3 March 2025) is in EDGAR under CIK 1498710. Its ticker now shows as SAVEQ and the entity as Spirit Aviation Holdings, Inc. A full-text search shows the 10-K uses these operating KPI terms:

| KPI | FY 2024 Total |
|---|---|
| Available seat miles (ASMs) | Not found with these tools |
| Revenue passenger miles (RPMs) | Not found with these tools |
| Passenger flight segments | Not found with these tools |
| Load factor | Not found with these tools |
| TRASM (total revenue per ASM) | Not found with these tools |
| CASM (cost per ASM) | Not found with these tools |

This list may be incomplete. The search only checks whether a term I typed appears in the filing. It doesn't return the filing's text, so I couldn't read the full operating statistics table, and the 10-K may report more KPIs than these six.

**What was missing**

- **Search results:** the full-text search returns only filing links and details, not the text or tables, so I couldn't read the values.
- **Structured data:** airline operating statistics usually aren't in the standard financial-statement data the SEC publishes. A direct query for a Spirit-specific ASM item came back "not found."
- **Full data dump:** Spirit's complete data list was too large to return here, and I had no way to search the saved file in this session.

To get the figures, open the "Operating Statistics" table in Item 7 (MD&A) of the 10-K at:
https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1498710/000149871025000008/save-20241231.htm

**Sources**
- Spirit Airlines, Inc. — Form 10-K for FY ended 31 Dec 2024, filed 2025-03-03, accession 0001498710-25-000008
